camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyRCDiskSpec --region cn-hangzhou --PerformanceLevel PL2 --DryRun false --DiskCategory cloud_essd --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoPay true --DiskId 'rcd-wz9f3peueu5npsl0000'
description_en: Changes the cloud disk type or performance level (PL) of an RDS Custom instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS Custom实例的云盘类型或性能级别
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-rc-disk-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id rcd-wz9f3peueu5npsl0000 --disk-category cloud_essd --performance-level PL2 --auto-pay true --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRCDiskSpec

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud disk. Valid values:
cloud_essd (default): ESSD cloud disk.
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
parameters.help_zh:
变更云盘的类型。取值：
cloud_essd（默认）：ESSD云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
parameters.name: disk_category

parameters.help_en:
The performance level (PL) of the ESSD cloud disk. Valid values:

PL1 (default): A maximum of 50,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

PL2: A maximum of 100,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

PL3: A maximum of 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per disk
parameters.help_zh:
修改ESSD云盘的性能级别。取值：

PL1（默认值）：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5 万。

PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10 万。

PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100 万
parameters.name: performance_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true (default): Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
false: Only an order is generated. No payment is made.

If your payment method has an insufficient balance, set AutoPay to false. An unpaid order is generated. You can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值：
true（默认值）：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
false：只生成订单不扣费。

如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this operation. Valid values:
true: A dry run is performed without executing the change. The check items include request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory.
false (default): A normal request is sent. After the check is passed, the change is directly executed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次节点变更的操作执行预检查。取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不执行变更。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行变更
parameters.name: dry_run
